snippet.title: The Fifth Bell | Atmospheric Indie Horror Game (Wishlist on Steam!)
snippet.description:
Discover The Fifth Bell — a short, atmospheric indie horror game set in an abandoned, gloomy village.
Your goal is to find 5 randomly spawned gifts… but don’t take too long. After a while, the Reaper will start hunting you.
🎮 Features:
Dark, creepy atmosphere of an old forgotten village
Random item locations = replayability
The Reaper mechanic adds constant tension
Short but intense horror experience
💀 Add the game to your Steam Wishlist now:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4040030/The_Fifth_Bell
📢 Content creators:
If you have a YouTube channel and want to record a video about the game, message me and I’ll provide you with a pre-release Steam key 🔑
